patch.title: Seattle Cherry Blossom & Japanese Cultural Festival Runs April 9–11, 2027
patch.description: Seattle’s Japanese cultural festival is scheduled for April 9–11, 2027, with daily hours of 11am–5pm at Seattle Center and free general admission.
patch.dateConfidenceReasoning: Scheduled: the organiser’s Plan Your Visit page explicitly says “Friday, April 9 and Sunday, April 11, 2027” and 11am–5pm daily. This supersedes the April month placeholder. The FAQ’s isolated2026 end-year typo conflicts with its own2027 heading/banner; the unambiguous Plan page is the date source. End is exclusive.
patch.longFormSummary:
• The organiser schedules the 52nd Seattle Cherry Blossom & Japanese Cultural Festival for April 9–11, 2027, 11am–5pm each day. This is the published2027 event window, replacing an estimate borrowed from the2026 edition.
  • The festival is based at Seattle Center. Its FAQ identifies the Armory, Fisher Pavilion and Exhibition Hall as the main festival spaces; the three-day listing on matsuri.guide agrees on dates, hours and location.
  • General admission is free. The organiser distinguishes entry from purchases such as food and artwork, and nearby parking has separate variable charges. Free admission therefore does not imply that every activity or visit expense is included.
  • The organiser says the2027 programme will be updated closer to the festival. The date announcement does not verify an older edition’s performers or individual sessions. Visitors should return to the organiser’s schedule for the final programme.
